compete = to take part in a race or contest and try to win
opponent = the person or team you play against
referee = the official who controls a football or rugby match
umpire = the official who controls tennis or volleyball
stadium = a large building with seats around a sports field
pitch = the grass area where football or rugby is played
court = the marked area for tennis, basketball or volleyball
track = the path used for running races
goalkeeper = the player who stops the ball going into the goal
score = to get a goal or point; the number of points
draw = a result where both sides have the same score
defeat = a loss; to win against someone
victory = the fact of winning
championship = a competition to decide the best team or player
tournament = a series of games until there is a winner
athlete = a person who is trained for sport, especially running or jumping
coach = a person who trains a team or player
training = regular practice to get better at a sport
warm-up = gentle exercise before a hard session
injury = damage to your body from sport or an accident
